A single screened affine mixture preserves the original dense/draft components and converts gate/up experts to two bits and down experts to three bits. It is an exact pinned research adapter, outside product installation, Engine planning and Auto. The bounded export and complete native screen are captured here before measurement transcription. Original installed weights remain unchanged.

Two generated three-bit expert trees contained identical payloads. Independent full-file hashes, open-file stamps and atomic hard-link replacement preserve both names and all unique data. The first attempt stopped before replacing any file because Python 3.9 does not support Path.stat(follow_symlinks=False). A frozen compatibility repair uses lstat, reauthenticates everything and coalesces all forty-eight duplicates. Neither an earlier reader receipt nor an original model file is rewritten. Physical staging, counted by allocated blocks rather than duplicated logical hard-link sizes, fits the existing 430-GB cap.

The next bounded export produces the exact complete manifest 1edbd2d7b01a1f15a185b3c4107feefb195c4e027c654c7f00dbdc981b4ad1c3. Its independently read-back tensor hashes and per-file sizes are retained. The native implementation accepts only that mixed identity, validates each projection geometry, and uses the down projection's own descriptor. Uniform original and three-bit behavior remains unchanged. It does not add a generic format framework or a public pack.

All seven sequential operations complete within the frozen physical/watchdog bounds: long traversal ordering, independent full-layer reference, native prefill parity across cache histories, sixteen self-fed greedy reference steps, native generation/cache parity, speculative generation/state/recovery, and the existing sixteen complete tasks. The numerical reference allowance is explicitly bounded to 2.1 GB total raw files after adding 28,682,240 parity bytes; this is not a new large quality-logit dataset. Global paging is retained as a diagnostic, and none of these functional durations is an eligible speed result.

The original passes fifteen of sixteen tasks; affine223 passes twelve. Both miss sort-records. New instruction/multilingual losses are contradictory-source and spanish-structured (fenced JSON despite explicit bare-JSON instructions), and hindi-structured (total 16 instead of 17). Every answer and deterministic grade is preserved. Do not strip fences or change grading after observing results. This misses the frozen fifteen-pass minimum, so no speed pilot or product promotion follows. It rejects this exact recipe, not every possible selective quantization. Preserve original as the preferred pack and proceed to the separately frozen original ten-GB baseline and fourteen-GB allocation experiment. The native quantization catalogue and affected Python tests pass; full final acceptance is separate.
